notes: GAAP (modified accrual funds). Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (p5); ending_cash = Balance Sheet total cash and cash equivalents 12,084,644 (p4; restricted cash 2,480,279 and CDs 87,500 shown separately). Taxes 9,162,908 split: Sales Tax Fund 4,110,565 (= Statement of Activities sales tax), Hotel/Motel Tax Fund 176,456 (lodging, fund name), TIF funds 217,579 (property tax increment, fund name); remaining 4,658,308 (General sub-fund, Debt Service, Street) stays unlabeled because the Statement of Activities breakdown does not tie and the budget schedules are budgetary basis. Warrant income 3,000,000 = debt_proceeds; sale of assets and insurance proceeds = other_financing. Business-type: Water + Sewer from p7 (operating + nonoperating; interest expense and bonding costs as debt service interest); proprietary cash flows from p8. Detail: General Fund budget schedules (revenues p12, expenditures/other financing p10; chosen over the less detailed General Fund combining statement p16 to avoid double counting; p16 folds General Fund debt service 124,963 into Library), Street Fund budget (p13-14), Keno Fund budget (p15), TIF funds combining statement (p17). Debt Service Fund and proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total column (p1-p2). Read pages 1-17 of 17
